notes:
EXP34-C ORACLE COVERAGE, PART B (strict-only keys), mosquitto: src/conf.c through src/subs.c. These 113 keys are in-scope EXP34-C findings that aurora-lint d21be1b3d reports only at the strict preset (run sqc-0.6.0-d21be1b3d-strict-*; strict sets first_site_only=false and reports every dereference site, not only the first) and that no label covers. Same standard and method as coverage-exp34c-2026-10-calibration and coverage-exp34c-2026-10-part-a-curl-hostap-mbedtls-mosquitto: the dereference is the violation site, judged at strict under EXP34-C/2026-10-07/presets; FP needs proof in the scanned source, a language guarantee, or an ISO C or POSIX library contract (those rows also cite P/facts); open caller sets for exported functions; a strippable assert, a noreturn attribute and an earlier dereference of the same pointer are not proof. A later site inherits an earlier site's FP only when that proof also dominates it with no reassignment between. One read-only research reader drafted each verdict at source in the pinned checkout; the adjudicator reviewed every draft (format and vocabulary, every nearby opposite-verdict label, a source re-read of a sample and of the questioned rows) before inclusion.

RESULT: 48 FP, 65 TP.

FP shapes: REQUIRE_* guards in src/conf.c; subs.c leaves and topic arrays from static callees that succeed only with a checked allocation. TP shapes: open broker functions whose base_msg, props, split_topics or stored parameters are checked only by assert() or not at all; the static global pollfds in mux_poll.c, NULL before init, after a failed calloc and after cleanup, reached from non-static mux_poll__* functions; service.c argv from an unchecked allocation; keepalive_list in open keepalive functions (medium).

15 row(s) name a conflict in provenance with a carried-forward label that predates the 2026-10-07 rulings; existing rows are not edited.

Counting basis: distinct (project, commit, file, line, rule) keys. No precision or recall claim is made here.
